name: Gadolinium tritelluride
equilibrium_context: Unidirectional charge density wave with coupled periodic lattice distortion, transition temperature about 380 K

driven_states.emergent_property: Long-lived metastable CDW state WITHOUT lattice distortion at photoinduced interfaces. This state has no amplitude mode - a purely electronic CDW correlation that quantifies the electronic part of the CDW instability.
driven_states.source: Duan et al., npj Quantum Materials 10 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41535-025-00742-x
driven_states.caveat: The state is spatially confined to photoinduced interfaces, not to the bulk. The interpretation as an interface with inverted lattice distortion rests on the absence of the amplitude mode and on band-structure signatures, not on a direct structural measurement.
driven_states.measured_quantity: time-resolved photoemission, absence of the amplitude mode

sources: Duan et al., npj Quantum Materials 10 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41535-025-00742-x
